commands:
set -euo pipefail
cd projects/kobra2-neo
JOB=/tmp/kobra-portrait-final-20260929-61/job
G="$JOB/output.gcode"
R="$JOB/report.json"
PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-130
EXPECTED_SOURCE=f8d654a8809802805c4fce869fee4ea3b554adb327f9e710b7d1dcbc47ea7f1a
EXPECTED_GCODE=d16d66c567e830458cc79742112bb9bb48a2bd30760dbedb24c6b852e39102ab
test -f "$G"
test -f "$R"
SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$G" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$SHA" = "$EXPECTED_GCODE"
.venv/bin/python - "$R" "$EXPECTED_SOURCE" "$EXPECTED_GCODE" <<'PY'
import json, sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r["source"]["sha256"] == sys.argv[2]
assert r["source"]["conversion"] == "none"
assert r["source"]["page_mm"] == [150.0,150.0]
assert r["geometry"]["geometry_preserved"] is True
assert r["geometry"]["path_simplification"] is False
assert r["geometry"]["path_merge"] is False
assert r["geometry"]["path_reversal"] is False
assert r["geometry"]["source_polylines"] == 6587
assert r["geometry"]["source_points"] == 87063
assert r["artifacts"]["gcode_sha256"] == sys.argv[3]
assert r["safety"]["valid"] is True
p=r["profile"]
assert p["pen_up_z"] == 4.97 and p["pen_down_z"] == 2.97
assert p["motion"]["travel_feed"] == 6000.0
assert p["motion"]["draw_feed"] == 2400.0
assert p["motion"]["z_feed"] == 360.0
PY
.venv/bin/kobra-live "$G" --report "$R" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --port "$PORT" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --progress-every 500 --thermal-check-every 5000
